notes.title: Leaderboards now in game
notes.notes: I'm happy to let you know that all your hard splatting has not been for nothing. Leaderboards are now visible in game on the game over summary screen. There will be some minor improvements to their layour in the next update but for now, go become number one!

notes.title: Horde mode now in game and bug fixes
notes.notes:
We have updated the gameplay to be in a horde based 'wave' system so you now have set targets to reach per wave rather than just a continuous horde from the beginning. 

We have also fixed the bug that prevented scores being uploaded to the leaderboards.

notes.title: Ready, Aim, Splat! is out now!
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce that Ready, Aim, Splat! - The VR veggie slinging game for the end of the world - is finally out. While we have released now, the game is far from complete and we look forward to providing you with updates, improvements and new content FREE in the coming months.


If you come across any issues with the game, please shoot a message through to [url=http://blue-volcano.com/ready-aim-splat-bug-report/]our bug reporting form	[/url]. before writing a negative review and we will work out the problem as soon as we can.
